31340131.desc_art: 沉默是她对悬念、伏笔、转折，以及所有推理小说的尊重。

desc:
“生日”这个纪念日对贝丽尔来说，并非没有任何意义。贝丽尔偶尔会在这一天为玛蒂尔达挑选礼物，并保留至玛蒂尔达的生日当日寄出。至今为止，每一件礼物都恰到好处，就像一颗与他者完美啮合的齿轮。|对任何知名的占卜师来说，公开自己的生日都是一件不利的事。因此鲜少有人知晓贝丽尔的生日，她自己也从未提及过。
人们传言：她不想将自己的命运，哪怕一角，摊开在其他蹩脚的占卜师眼前。事实上，这仅仅是因为，除了基金会档案抄写员，少有人主动询问她。|玛蒂尔达在法国的外勤任务途中，寄来了慕斯蛋糕与马卡龙。贝丽尔将这些法式甜品分享给了箱中的孩子们，她迅速赢取了他们的欢心。这天以后，孩子们无不对她毕恭毕敬，当然这也引起了牙仙的关注。
useDesc: 承载了珍贵记忆的彩色相片，可用于邀请此神秘学家。
desc2: 窥探将至未至之事的占卜师，惯于预言未来的涟漪或沉寂，你最熟络命运的朋友之一。

character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，展出于20世纪30年代，参展时长不详，诞生自12月21日冬。原参展地点不明，曾活跃于世界各地，一度疑似遗失，现于圣洛夫基金会进行检测，预计不日将重启巡展。

尺寸：65 3/4×30 3/64×18 27/32in.
介质：水晶折射
香调：西普调 香根草 柏树 杜松 檀香木 紫罗兰
灵感：既定的图景[智] 观审者

character_data.title: 最理想的介质
character_data.text:
一块纯净无瑕的水晶，生来便比同类更擅长捕捉那些隐秘的流光。
少许角度偏转即可令它映出绚烂光华，只是其本身的色彩也因此难以被准确描述。
每一道光线穿过它后都改变了方向，无人知晓介质自身是否曾发生变化。

character_data.title: 尘世之眼
character_data.text:
工房最杰出的作品之一，崭新的躯壳令这种脆弱的生灵再无惧于时移事迁。
当它偶尔振翅跃入空中时，阳光下映出的光彩足以留驻任何人的目光。
受访者并未否认该物品在商业宣传方面的卓越效果。

character_data.title: 本应无用之物
character_data.titleEn: What Was Meant to Be Small
character_data.text: 年幼的女孩稚拙但一丝不苟地完成了人生中第一次的打磨与抛光，用钟爱的丝带将引以为傲的作品串起，赠予最爱的母亲。尽管因技艺稚嫩，与受访者身上其他精美的饰品相比难免略显朴素，不过从磨损的痕迹来看，这条手环已被佩戴多年。

character_data.title: 三十年代精神
character_data.text:
和平街的那家店铺被人盘了下来，买主是一位年轻的女士。和近旁其他商铺相比，这间铺子的性价比并不高，房地产经纪人问起原因，得到了这样的回答——“布翁尼的铺子将会开在这里。”

这个名字在短短几个月内便传遍了巴黎，奏响在每一场舞会或是沙龙中，流连在每一个追逐时尚的女孩的唇齿间。精巧绝伦的水晶制品足以打动每一双追逐美的眼睛，而那传说中偶尔会附赠的特殊卡片，更是令任何一个对自身尚存关心的人竞相追逐。

当然，偶尔也会有客人看着橱窗中的标价咂舌。这个十年在那场前所未有的经济危机中拉开序幕，一度自命为“繁荣仅存的孤岛”的法兰西第三共和国，最终也没能逃脱厄运。迟来的冲击，令复苏和重建也来得更慢些。春天时阴影褪去，伤口却尚未愈合。

每当此时，水晶工房的女主人总会露出表示理解的微笑。

“我们有不同价位的商品可供选择。何况……您瞧。
“如今有人为了守住和平的日子而奔走，为扭转倾颓的局势呐喊，这些美丽的水晶就和那些美好的愿望一样。总要抓住眼前的某个事物，人们才有迈向未知的勇气，哪怕被视作愚不可及。
“每个时代都是如此。”

character_data.title: 祝福抑或诅咒
character_data.text:
在女儿出生后的很长一段时间里，布翁尼夫妇都忧心忡忡。

尚在襁褓中的她总是啼哭不止，无论布翁尼夫妇如何尝试安抚，那双圆滚滚的大眼睛总是泪眼朦胧地望向虚空中不知名的方向。年龄尚小时她还会牙牙学语，咿咿呀呀地想要说些什么，可随着年龄的增长，她却越发沉默……

克莱琳娜带着女儿走访了不少名医，却都查不出个所以然，她最终不得不拜访了一位原本打算老死不相往来的占卜师——出众的占卜技艺让那人总是一副高高在上的姿态，克莱琳娜并不喜欢对方。

可令她惊讶的是，在占卜过后，对方的表情变了。

“你的女儿并没有问题，她只是……拥有一种惊人的天赋。”

本应艰深晦涩的占卜技艺对这个孩子而言总是轻而易举，她似乎受到了神明的眷顾，无需特意施术，一些预言与征兆便自行出现在眼前……寻求某种启示的人们蜂拥而至，布翁尼家的水晶生意也因此蒸蒸日上。

可克莱琳娜始终忘不了当年那名占卜师欲言又止的表情。

“克莱琳娜……你要知道，这不一定是件好事。”

character_data.title: 合作意向
character_data.text:
白雪松：我们都知道您是一名成功的商人，出自“布翁尼”工房的水晶制品总是橱窗中最受欢迎的那个。但我们也知道您还有另一个身份——占卜师。
白雪松：听说您做出的占卜从未出过错，这是真的吗？
贝丽尔：如果您指的是那些偶尔附在匣子里，和货品一起寄出的卡片上写的话语……据我所知，的确如此。
白雪松：这实在是太不可思议了。要知道，就连公认最权威的那本《应用神秘术：现代占卜理论与方法》，都在导论中写到过“每一个占卜师都可能出错”……
白雪松：您究竟是如何做到的？可以和我们的读者朋友们透露一下您的秘诀吗？
贝丽尔：呵……抱歉，这可是商业机密。
白雪松：所以那些小赠品是营销策略的一环咯？听说您还曾悬赏说如果谁能够打破您的预言，您愿意提供一笔丰厚的奖金。
白雪松：这个悬赏还有效吗？
贝丽尔：当然，它始终有效。
白雪松：这是一个好消息，也许会有些读者对此感兴趣。不过遗憾的是据我所知，您的产品目前似乎购买渠道仍十分有限？
贝丽尔：我们正在着手解决这个问题。
贝丽尔：我在想……您的杂志拥有极为广大的读者群体，也许您会对一次联名合作有兴趣？
白雪松：让我猜猜看，这和今早邮送到编辑部的那箱包裹有关？
贝丽尔：是的。
白雪松：看来您早已预见到了我的答案。

character_data.title: “注定响奏”
character_data.text:
一架难掩使用痕迹的华美竖琴。再富有天赋的演奏者，其事业也并非一蹴而就，受访者将努力尽付它震颤的丝弦，在其陪伴下弹奏过无数个夜晚。
被问及是否早已预见舞台上的未来时，受访者并不否认。
“不过，我仍然享受指尖每一次切实的颤动。预言所见无法替代只此一刻的体验。”

character_data.title: 适度华丽披帛
character_data.text:
一条坠有珠链的深色披帛。受访者挑选它，因其使演出时的一切都“恰到好处”——恰好将多数视线引导向拨弦的双手；恰好令受访者的闪耀程度在舞台上不至突兀；而演出结束，又恰好让观众惊叹她落手时一闪而过的光彩。
“我称它为‘适度’设计理念。”受访者如此总结，笔者亦对其表示认同。

character_data.title: 水晶链饰样品
character_data.text:
妆点着金属与水晶的链状头饰，每枚嵌片皆由受访者亲手选就，以期其足够流光溢彩。而万众瞩目的舞台正是一处绝佳的广告位——帷幕拉开后，“布翁尼”的名号将随链饰一同在射灯下焕发光彩。
谈及其后续销售计划，受访者透露，布翁尼工房正与主办方就联名合作进行洽谈。

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 噢，这就是“手提箱”的内部……玛蒂尔达曾多次提到过。很荣幸能造访这儿。#0|我们之间有太多话题可聊，我并不急于此刻。#8.1
character_voice.encontent: Ah, the inside of the suitcase ... a place Matilda has often spoken of. It is an honor to finally see it for myself.#0|We have much to speak about, you and I—how fortunate that we have been granted the time to do so.#11

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 漫长的雨季。世界因此解体，永远处于黏腻的变化中。#0|但我并不排斥这样的生活。#7.9
character_voice.encontent: This rainy season—in which the world is broken down, reshaped, and toyed with like wet clay—will be a long one.#0|Still, I do not find the uncertainty unpleasant.#11.2

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 若是以前，这会是一个笃定而无趣的问题。#0|辉耀之下，我的未来与过去没有不同。#5.2|如今……维尔汀，我等待命运的谜底自你身上显露的时刻。我对此有所期待。#9.5
character_voice.encontent: The future—had you spoken on it earlier, it would have been a dull, predictable subject.#0|Once, beneath the Sephirot's glow, I saw it as plainly as the past.#8.4|But now, with so much changed, I find myself just as curious as any to see where fate will lead us.#15.3

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 真实隐藏在沉默之中，#0|我欣赏你适时的无言，这便于我看得更清。#3.3
character_voice.encontent: Silence often holds truths far greater than any words.#0|I appreciate you letting it speak—there are things which are more easily revealed to me in the quiet.#6.45

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 混沌可提炼为疑问，获得答案后便可建构秩序。#0|但对“看不见”的人而言，#5.3|无意义的随机之中，生存才显出意义……#7.8|你好，请坐。#13.6
character_voice.encontent: Du chaos naissent les questions, et dans leurs réponses, nous trouvons l'ordre.#0|Pour ceux qui ne voient pas la voie du destin, la vie n'est qu'une mer en tumulte. #4.5|Mais en apprenant à la naviguer, on peut y trouver un sens.#9.45|Ah, je vous en prie ... entrez.#14

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 又一次无声的造访。我尊重你试图让我感到“意外”的努力——#0|你可以享用桌上的玛德琳蛋糕，这次就能有所收获，不必失望而归。#7.6
character_voice.encontent: Another quiet visit? I do appreciate your attempts to bring some "surprise" into my life.#0|There are madeleines on the table—take one. Let your efforts yield at least some small reward.#9.35

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 太阳若不升起，人们便会惊慌。#0|人们需要这不变的时刻来获得慰藉，却拒不接受自己的人生如此周而复始。#3.6|孕育这一矛盾的人心奥秘，无论何时都无法由预言揭晓。#11.55
character_voice.encontent: Were the sun not to rise in the morning, dread would befall the world.#0|The constants of life console us, yet when given a life of constants, we soon grow numb.#6|We are all walking contradictions—and thus, it is never quite possible to wholly divine our futures.#14.75

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 请小心，占卜妖精总是跟随着占卜师的脚步。#0|它们没有恶意，不过是好奇贪玩，但时常也令人无奈。#4.8|歇店前整理好的水晶，总会在晚上被它们弄得一团糟……#10.35
character_voice.encontent: Mind the divination sprites—they have a habit of following diviners like myself.#0|They are not malicious, merely curious and willfully ignorant of house rules.#7|No matter how carefully I lock up the night before, the crystals are always in disarray by morning ...#14

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 我居然也会说出这样一句话：“没想到，有朝一日我会睡在手提箱里。”#0|这并非指责你招待不周，而是惊喜的感叹。这是我如今珍惜的情绪。#7.3
character_voice.encontent: "I slept in a suitcase last night." Words I never expected to speak.#0|I mean no reproach—the experience was ... refreshing. After all, novelty has ever been a rarity in my life.#8.65

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 我与玛蒂尔达截然不同，但相似的发色依旧证明了我们之间的血缘关系。#0|当然，我想她更渴望作为“优秀的占卜师”被人铭记。#6.9
character_voice.encontent: Beyond the hair on our heads, Matilda and I share few similarities.#0|I suspect she would rather be remembered as a powerful diviner than simply as my daughter.#6.8

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 我时常会去荒原里那片麦田看看，六棱大麦长得饱满，落在掌心里沉甸甸的。#0|芭妮芭妮小姐告诉我，结穗后成熟的籽粒若以不同温度烘烤，#7.9|就能酿造不同口感的酒水。#13.2|我很欣赏她的用心劳作与悉心介绍，但也是时候回绝她再来一杯的邀请了。#17.1
character_voice.encontent: I often wander the fields in the Wilderness to feel the heavy ears of barley against my palms.#0|Ms. Bunny Bunny tells me that, when baked at various temperatures, #7.5|they may produce a variety of alcohols.#12.2|Though I admire her dedication to her craft, I feel it is best I abstain from her next tasting session.#15.8

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 其他布翁尼常说：“一枚世间独有的水晶，净度极高，纯粹透明，#0|以便辉耀穿行而过，不受滞留地充盈物质世界。”#6.6
character_voice.encontent: Bien des Bouaniches m'ont dit : « Tu es un cristal d'une clarté rare, #0|par lequel l'énergie divine des Séphiroth s'écoule sans entrave vers le monde matériel. »#4.8

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 溯流而上的人，会与顺水而下的人一同被河流吞没。#0|过去他们如此孱弱，只如石子投河，但我也乐于注视他们溅起的水花。#6.1|现在，我们都能有所满足。#14.6|失去注定方向的河流里，意志得证自我的真实，水花也终于能哺育奇迹的诞生。#19.5
character_voice.encontent: Those who resisted the current and those who surrendered to it were both carried off by the river.#0|They were fragile back then, mere pebbles cast into the water, yet I found some joy in watching the splashes they made along the way.#8|But now, it seems, we may all find satisfaction.#20.2|For the river has lost its course, and what was once just a splash now carves a current all its own.#25.4

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 溯流而上的人，会与顺水而下的人一同被河流吞没。#0|过去他们如此孱弱，只如石子投河，但我也乐于注视他们溅起的水花。#6.1|现在，我们都能有所满足。#14.6|失去注定方向的河流里，意志得证自我的真实，水花也终于能哺育奇迹的诞生。#19.5
character_voice.encontent: Those who resisted the current and those who surrendered to it were both carried off by the river.#0|They were fragile back then, mere pebbles cast into the water, yet I found some joy in watching the splashes they made along the way.#8|But now, it seems, we may all find satisfaction.#20.2|For the river has lost its course, and what was once just a splash now carves a current all its own.#25.4

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 你惯于与未知相处，#0|面对你，我成为了提问者。#2.4
character_voice.encontent: You are no stranger to the unknown—you have even made a companion of it.#0|It seems, with you, that I am the one with questions to ask.#7.75

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 长时间靠近那片湖泊，雾气总会让我失去意识，#0|如果有一位能保持清醒的人为我观测占卜结果就再好不过了……#5|维尔汀，你愿意同行吗？#11.1
character_voice.encontent: The mist that hangs about the lake seems to send those who enter it into a temporary state of unconsciousness.#0|If only there were someone immune to its effects who could join me to witness the results of my divination ... #9.8|Well, Vertin? Would you grant me the favor?#18

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 过去，我想乐曲是最接近人们生存境遇的形式，#0|音符被规定在乐谱上，一路演奏至终点。#5.25|但对于远旅小姐而言，自然小调可以为她传达关切，D大调可以为她言说欢欣——#9.7|此刻，我似乎理解为什么人们相信乐曲演奏的力量了。#19.2
character_voice.encontent: I once saw music only as a metaphor for fate—#0|a pre-written melody played until our song's end.#4|But Ms. Voyager sees it altogether differently. To her, a natural minor might convey a tender concern, D major a bright joy.#9|I see now its quiet power, and how deeply it can stir the heart.#22.5

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 直到现在，依旧有人假借“布翁尼”的名头行销劣质水晶。#0|为了维护工房的名声，追查工作麻烦却有必要。#5.9|但偶尔他们也为我行了好处——在虚假之中，价值才能“真实”地存在。#11
character_voice.encontent: There are still those who sell tarnished crystals under the Bouanich name.#0|It is a time-consuming task to root them all out, but necessary if we are to preserve our reputation.#6.5|And in time, as the hazards of the false are made plain, the true crystals will gleam all the brighter.#15.9

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 与命运周旋的最好方式，是停留于“追寻”而非求得答案。#0|享受行于岔路时的迷茫，提心吊胆于选择的后果……#5.8|噢，如果真有一日雨会停下，我想我会怀念现在的日子。#11
character_voice.encontent: Rester fidèle à soi-même, c'est se rappeler que c'est le voyage, et non son terme, qui compte le plus.#0|Savoure les instants du chemin ... hésite aux carrefours, crains la route devant toi, doute de tes choix ...#7.5|Si un jour la Tempête s'éteint, ces jours me manqueront.#16.25

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 合作愉快。#0
character_voice.encontent: Let us see what we will achieve together.#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 水流再次交汇。#0
character_voice.encontent: Many streams are converging in this place.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 辉耀流经之处。#0
character_voice.encontent: Dérive dans le flot des Séphiroth.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 是其所是的命运。#0
character_voice.encontent: Comme l'a scellé le destin.#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 注定的选择。#0
character_voice.encontent: A destined choice.#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 一瞥其真相。#0
character_voice.encontent: A glimpse beneath the veil.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 命运已显露眼前。#0
character_voice.encontent: Fate has revealed itself to you.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 人人被网罗其中。#0
character_voice.encontent: Prey caught in the woven net.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 已泛起涟漪。#0
character_voice.encontent: A ripple stirred.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 已泛起涟漪。#0
character_voice.encontent: A ripple stirred.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 已向我敞开。#0
character_voice.encontent: A secret revealed.#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 辉耀于此化形。#0
character_voice.encontent: Sept en tout révèlent les Séphiroth.#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.encontent: Oh.#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: *一声无奈的叹息*#0
character_voice.encontent: *resigned sigh*#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 原来如此。#0|这就是不再经由占卜，#1.75|而由“我”抉择的结局。#4.25
character_voice.encontent: Voilà donc ce que c'est ...#0|atteindre la fin, non par la prophétie,#2.2|mais par mes propres mains.#5.6

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 我曾一瞥“它”的存在，#0|超越言语的美丽让我意识到自己的狭隘。#2.5|然而，“看见”便意味着拥有形式。它比我想的更亲近我们的世界。#7.1
character_voice.encontent: I once caught a glimpse of its true form—#0|a beauty so indescribable that, in its presence, I was made keenly aware of my flaws.#4.35|And yet, if mortal eyes may perceive it, perhaps it is not so far from us as I once imagined.#14

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 涉足这条“河流”，便要接受摸索方向时石子划破掌心，#0|步伐也会踉跄——#5.1|我将前所未有的狼狈，于是，我也“活着”了。#7.5
character_voice.encontent: To step into this "river" is to grow accustomed to groping in its waters,#0|the body tattered and bruised along the way.#5.1|One emerges in a sorry state indeed—yet, perhaps this is what it means to be alive.#9.3

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 涉足这条“河流”，便要接受摸索方向时石子划破掌心，步伐也会踉跄——#0|我将前所未有的狼狈，于是，我也“活着”了。#7.5
character_voice.encontent: To step into this "river" is to grow accustomed to groping in its waters, the body tattered and bruised along the way.#0|One emerges in a sorry state indeed—yet, perhaps this is what it means to be alive.#9.3

character_voice.name: 特殊交互1
character_voice.content: 光，织就存在的灵性，却落在我们衰落的洞察之外。#0|于是占卜，借助水晶之于光的亲近，映射光于现象世界的倒影，#6.3|拂去灵性所覆的尘埃，赋予本质一念的真相。#12.5|择选灵性的指引吧，它将为你从碎屑中抽丝剥茧，塑造启迪。#18.1
character_voice.encontent: Pneuma, though captured in light, is a power which lies beyond our comprehension.#0|Through crystal, a diviner may focus that light, drawing it forth into this world as a single, discernible point.#7|And thus, we may grant a fleeting glimpse of truth.#16.9|So, choose the sphere of pneuma which calls to you, and let it be your guide.#21.6

character_voice.name: 特殊交互2
character_voice.content: 启示已刺入物质世界，命运的预兆就此显现。#0|保持这份敏锐，我很期待你将如何诠释这一“光”的图景。#5.4
character_voice.encontent: The light has pierced the veil between worlds—and brought with it a prophecy.#0|Keep your senses clear. I am quite curious to hear what truths it reveals to you.#7

character_voice.name: 特殊交互3
character_voice.content: 面对幽微糅杂的现象，犹疑也是在所难免——#0|不必急于此刻，不妨期待下一束辉光照耀之时。#4.3
character_voice.encontent: It is only natural to hesitate before the unknown.#0|There is no need to rush—the light will find its way to you, in time.#4.6

character_voice.name: 入场
character_voice.content: 一处耸立于河心的孤屿，漩涡与湍流从旁经过，人们得以在选择的纷繁中歇脚。#0|……请放心，我并非在探寻任何人的前路，#11.6|我只是在期待，从这扇门走出后，属于我的支流又会流向何方。#16.1
character_voice.encontent: A steady point in the ever-flowing river—an island respite, where the weary may rest before braving the current again ...#0|There is no need to be concerned; I do not intend to pry into anyone's fate.#11.5|For now, I wish only to discern what course my own stream may take when we set forth again.#17.7

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 在我转动这枚棱晶时，其中出现了你的倒影。#0|我们都知晓，这并非偶然。#4.62
character_voice.encontent: The crystal catches the light, and within it, your image emerges—#0|you and I both know such things are no coincidence.#6.07

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 啊，一片纤薄孱弱的晶体。#0|玛蒂尔达小的时候曾试图寻找一片“标准”的雪花——对称，有序，完美。#5.4|然而，即使“完美”存在，手心的温度，也只会令其更快消融……#14.43
character_voice.encontent: Un cristal de neige, délicat et éphémère.#0|There was a time Matilda was enamored by the notion of a perfect form—a snowflake of absolute symmetry. #5.28|Yet even precision offers no reprieve from fate, and in an instant, they vanished from her palm.#17.94

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 原本的生长轨迹因一条裂缝改变，确定性逐渐消融于未知中……#0|世界与我手中的这枚水晶如此相似。#8.07
character_voice.encontent: A crystal need only be severed from its formation for certainty to fracture into uncertainty.#0|There are many things in this world which fall all too easily to the slightest change in current.#9.91

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 在世界的缓慢转动中，碎片分合，图景与旋律更迭不息……#0|在这样的时刻，前行与驻足并无本质差别，#9.4|我们只是恰巧待在了这儿。#14.73
character_voice.encontent: With each turn, the kaleidoscope parts and converges its colors in ever-changing patterns.#0|One cannot help but wonder whether there is any meaningful difference between action and inaction,#9.06|when both have already been accounted for in fate's design.#17.7

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 晶体磨损、光线偏移……任何细微的变化都会令水晶的折射有所偏差。#0|……嗯？我并不是说你挡住了水晶折射的光。#8.85
character_voice.encontent: Surface abrasions, changes in light—many things may alter the light refracted by a crystal ...#0|Hm? No, I did not mean to suggest that you were obstructing the light.#9.25

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 人们在日光下穿戴整齐，于秩序内日复一日地生活：#0|办公桌前的蹙眉，打翻的胡椒博士与发出嘶吼声的唱片机。#5.52|这原本并不新鲜，但水晶转动，光线变换，别样的色彩便会染上这景象。#12.25
character_voice.encontent: In the Suitcase, patterns repeat more often than one might expect: #0|furrowed brows before opened files, toppled soft drink cans, roaring record players.#6.08|Yet through the crystal, I see a different arrangement taking shape.#15.54

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 琴弦颤动，与共鸣箱彼此应和，构成物质的最小单位一刻不停地运作着。#0|我习惯用弹奏迎来清晨，#9.27| 规律的颤动，可以如钟表一般记录流逝的时间。#12.23
character_voice.encontent: As the strings are plucked, the soundbox hums and vibrates, and the air within begins to resonate.#0|I have always found beauty in playing in the morning,#10.3| each pleasing note falling into place with the certainty of a clock's tick.#14.92

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 舞台、合奏、一个光芒璀璨的夜晚……于入席者而言，仅是乐声和鸣的幻梦；#0|于你我而言，却是现实无限复杂的一次折射。#9.72
character_voice.encontent: A grand stage, an orchestra, a starlit sky ... A dreamlike night of music for most.#0|Yet for you and me, it is a vision. A glimpse of what might have been, refracted in crystal.#12.1

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 倒错的光线坠入尘世，月亮的碎片沉至水底，映照于其中的城市不再由砖石与瓦片构成，#0|而我们匆匆掠过城市上空。#10.7|身后，辉光如此闪烁着。#14.03
character_voice.encontent: Where light descended and the moon shimmered in the reflections of a city aglow, #0|we too passed.#7.08|The moon illuminated us then, just as it does now.#9.35

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 在这样的奇妙夜晚，思绪往往更自由地游弋……#0|寂静无声时，我听见它们在头脑中谱就的乐声。#5.95
character_voice.encontent: On nights like these, when the world falls quiet, my thoughts wander freely ...#0|For silence has a way of revealing harmonies otherwise unheard.#9.32

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 曾经的我能够听见潜藏于琴弦中的每一个音，如同水晶知晓自己折射出的每一束光。#0|如今，我对自己奏出的曲调倒是抱有期待了。#9.55
character_voice.encontent: Once, every song was as predictable to me as the light's path through a crystal.#0|But now, there are melodies whose endings I cannot foresee, and I find myself listening all the more closely.#9.09

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 为了减少磨损，保持其光辉，人们常用柔软的绸缎包裹水晶……#0|是的，你说得没错，正如我的穿着。#8.5
character_voice.encontent: People often wrap their crystals in soft cloth to preserve their brilliance ...#0|Yes, I suppose this silk dress serves a similar purpose.#6.6

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 我更倾向于那些尚未完成的事物，它们无需服从任何既定的意义。#0|正像舞动的人群、随性的演奏、纷飞的歌声，于此时此刻，它们都是自由的。#6.5
character_voice.encontent: I have always favored the unfinished—the spontaneous and open to possibility.#0|A crowd mid-dance, a performance born in the moment, a song yet unsung ... There is beauty in all of them.#8.68

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 我喜欢你为这首乐曲加入的即兴节，这使它多了许多惊喜。#0|同样的乐声再次奏响时，我期待着你的灵感还会再次迸发。#5.85
character_voice.encontent: Your improvisation alongside my music was a charming surprise.#0|I do hope inspiration strikes you again next time I play.#6.22

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 若有一天幻象变为现实，灯火倒流至舞台，#0|我们共同沐浴其中，合奏的乐声掀起夜幕……#4.59|我很期待再次与你同台演出，维尔汀。#11.64
character_voice.encontent: Perhaps one day, the spotlight will shine once more, memory will yield to reality, #0|and we will all find ourselves together on that stage again ...#8.84|I shall look forward to it, Vertin.#14.53

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 玛蒂尔达小时候也曾摆弄着万花筒，#0|朝里面看个不停，并对我说：“妈妈，这里面有一整个水晶世界。”#2.93|……她一向聪慧如此。#11.93
character_voice.encontent: Matilda passait autrefois des heures à regarder dans son kaléidoscope.#0|Les yeux écarquillés, elle me parlait du « petit monde fait de cristaux » qu'elle y avait découvert. #5.18|She has always been a perceptive girl.#13.53

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 微量的杂质为透明晶体染上色彩，红宝石与祖母绿就此形成。#0|这就如同一些极小的延迟、提前与杂音能令乐曲变得鲜活。#6.18
character_voice.encontent: A gemstone's color is often born from its imperfections. Music is much the same.#0|It is the subtle deviations brought by the player's hands which truly make it memorable.#10.18

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 光悬于城市之上，音乐没有终点。#0|通常情况下，我不会称其为现实，它更接近纯粹与美好的意象，也因此值得无数次回味。#3.73
character_voice.encontent: That night, aglow with music, seems to have no end. #0|Though the event has passed, it remains within me still—an ever-resonating song in my mind.#6.77

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 命运，需要一次小小的转调。#0
character_voice.encontent: Destiny calls for a change in key.#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 虚幻的一夜。#0
character_voice.encontent: A beautifully unreal night.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 稳定的结构……#0
character_voice.encontent: A well-balanced structure.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 还需恰到好处的离调。#0
character_voice.encontent: The melody turns its course.#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 由此奏响。#0
character_voice.encontent: Listen, the first theme plays.#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 倒错，巡游……#0
character_voice.encontent: Un cortège de possibles.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 拼凑虚幻。#0
character_voice.encontent: A refracted reality.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 或为真实。#0
character_voice.encontent: A tangible illusion.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 交织的光线。#0
character_voice.encontent: Within a lattice of light ...#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 永不停留。#0
character_voice.encontent: To see the patterns turn ...#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 命运于弦上折射。#0
character_voice.encontent: And now, the crescendo of fate.#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.content: ……必经的小节。#0
character_voice.encontent: One measure of the inevitable.#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 一点裂痕。#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 无论见过多少令人目眩的可能性，#0|我都难以忘怀这璀璨闪烁的一夜。#3.3
character_voice.encontent: The infinite possibilities of fate have always dazzled me,#0|yet none outshine the brilliance of this night.#5.46

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 当内在的秩序自行构建，晶体得以生长，韵律也由此织就。#0
character_voice.encontent: From inherent order, a crystal is formed, and a melody emerges.#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 河流向下湍行，水花飞溅，亦如奏鸣。#0|旁观或涉足，聆听或演奏，我已做出了选择。#5.47
character_voice.encontent: Au fil du courant, la rivière devient brume scintillante. Certains entendent sa musique, d'autres suivent son rythme.#0|Choisir de jouer ou d'écouter est une décision que chacun doit prendre.#11.21

character_voice.name: 特殊交互1
character_voice.content: 来吧，一窥那闪烁的世界……#0
character_voice.encontent: Come, let us glimpse that starlit night ...#0

character_voice.name: 特殊交互2
character_voice.content: 其间纵有万般可能……却终究收束为一。#0
character_voice.encontent: Countless paths lie before each of us, yet few realize they will one day converge into a single course.#0

character_voice.name: 特殊交互3
character_voice.content: 你的选择便是既定的可能，无需惋惜。#0
character_voice.encontent: Your choice was carried here by the stream of fate. There is no need to mourn what simply could not have been.#0

character_voice.name: 入场
character_voice.content: 无数可能性坍缩为一个坚固而确定的晶体，其上折射出的可能性仍是无穷的。#0
character_voice.encontent: Toutes les possibilités se figent en un unique cristal, et chaque facette reflète un monde qui aurait pu être.#0

skin.name: 释命运以弦音
skin.skinDescription: 即使每一节变奏都已书于谱面，亦需亲手拨动命运的丝弦。
skin.skinStory:
她于水晶中得见那些变幻的、流动的、闪烁着的影像：
夜幕下的城市如万花筒般盛开，千万条名为命运的谱线流过倒悬的楼宇、月亮与天际，在宝石的每个切面中演绎出一幕幕未曾揭晓的剧情，无数人曾穷其一生叩问那些命运的未知，而水晶中似乎已浮现出了那朦胧的答案。
她却将它轻轻翻转，任那些预言沉入掌心，她闭上眼，拨动琴弦——
一声清响沿着城市的屋脊奔涌，顷刻间，命运由一面镜中跃入另一面镜中，那些沉睡于其中的瞬间随乐声一同旋转——诞生、相逢与离别，化作千万枚灼亮的碎片，无数命运汇聚、交叠，奏响同一首梦幻而灿烂的乐曲。
乐声沉寂，水晶的光芒悄然散去，最后一颗星停在她的指尖，仍发出细小的颤音。

1321011.content: 玛蒂尔达曾向我描述过箱中地貌的变化无常。
但亲眼见证后，我需承认，它的有趣程度超过了语言的描绘。
一处不可预知的变化之地，今日是山麓，明日为溪水……
维尔汀，你的周围还有多少谜团尚待解答呢？
但我确实有一些……全新的收获。
在昨天，我第一次体会了“迷路”。
我也得以第一次有机会向别人问路。我接连问了好几个人，大家对路线有不同的猜测。
这不是抱怨，那半小时的经历非常新奇。
当然，不是每个人都欣赏“迷路”这件事的。
阿黛拉曾经打算在箱中重操旧业。
但因为这些变化，她的想法可没法轻易实现了。

1321012.content: 呵呵……最近总有孩子来向我询问谁会是胜利者。
都与那个叫“小怪物翻斗棋”的游戏有关。
维尔汀，听说你玩这个很在行？有不少人都看好你。
原来你也想提前拥有一个既定的答案么？但很可惜……
答案会让游戏的乐趣消失，连观看者的乐趣也一并剥夺。
让我多享受一点未知的乐趣吧？我预约了决赛的观众席位哦。
是吗？难怪她那么在意这个游戏的输赢。
每当有孩子好奇地问我这个问题，玛蒂尔达就会找借口离开。
出于一个母亲对女儿的了解，她恐怕不会占卜这件事。
玛蒂尔达总是如此，她愿意付出努力，直至取得想要的成果。
甚至连“暴雨”这样无常的扰动，都没有改变她这一点。
玛蒂尔达也占卜过答案？
